## Comprehensive Codebase Analysis — C# Scripts in Unity Project

I read ~70+ files across the entire codebase. The main game code lives under **`Assets/Flynn/`** (not `Assets/Scripts/`, which contains only demo/prototype scripts). Below is a thorough breakdown organized by system.

---

## 1. ASSETS/SCRIPTS (Demo / Prototype folder — 9 files)

These are lightweight demos for LLM NPC chat, intro sequences, and 2D tilemap running.

### `Assets/Scripts/Demos/LlmChat/Runtime/Gameplay/`
- **`Game.cs`**: Empty placeholder `MonoBehaviour` — no logic.
- **`IsometricCameraFollow.cs`**: Smooth-follow camera. Public: `target` (Transform), `smoothSpeed`. Tracks a target with lerp offset.
- **`IsometricGridBuilder.cs`**: Builds an isometric checkerboard floor (BoxCollider + visual quads) at Awake. Width/depth, two colours. The Collider is for a CharacterController.
- **`PlayerBillboard.cs`**: Faces child sprite toward camera Y-axis (isometric stable billboarding).
- **`PlayerController.cs`**: Isometric CharacterController-based movement. Uses `IsoRight (1,0,-1)`/`IsoForward (1,0,1)` axes. Has a visual "bounce" system (sine-wave squash/stretch, Z-axis lean). Clamped to grid bounds.

### `Assets/Scripts/Demos/IntroSequence/Runtime/`
- **`IntroSequencePlayer.cs`**: Full cinematic intro system using UI Toolkit. Plays a sequence of text boxes with typewriter effect (per-character fade-in), frame fade transitions, and a final full-screen fade-to-game. Supports Space-to-skip. Configurable timing, font, responsive layout. Uses unscaled time by default. The `PlaySequence()` coroutine manages the show.

### `Assets/Scripts/Demos/LLM Demo/`
- **`Mover.cs`**: Simple point-A-to-point-B ping-pong movement.

### `Assets/Scripts/Demos/PrototypeRunner/Runtime/`
- **`SimpleSquareRunner2D.cs`**: 2D top-down movement on a Tilemap (probes 9 sample points for walkability). Has deceleration/acceleration, sprite flip on facing, run bounce (squash/stretch), and a direction-indicator arrow (TextMeshPro) that smoothly rotates.
- **`PrototypeActionFeedbackSystem.cs`**: Singleton world-space feedback popup (fades in, rises, holds, fades out). 4 tones (Info/Success/Warning/Error). Triggers after the intro sequence. Deployable via static `Show()`.

---

## 2. ASSETS/FLYNN — THE MAIN GAME

### SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE PATTERN
The codebase follows a consistent **observer/event-channel pattern**:
- **Singleton managers** (`ResourceManager`, `PlayerInventory`, `UIManager`, `RobotBattery`, `SceneLlmManager`) — early execution order, reached via `Instance`.
- **ScriptableObject event channels** (`ResourceHitChannel`, `DialogueTriggerChannel`, `RecalledKnowledgeChannel`) — decouple producers from consumers.
- **`PlayerMouseAimer`** as the single source of truth for mouse-over detection (reads `MousePointer` singleton).
- **`IPlayerVisual` interface** — decouples wrench/throw/rope controllers from the visual body (legacy sprite-sheet driver OR procedural cube rig).

---

## 3. PLAYER SYSTEM (Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/)

### Core Movement
- **`SolarpunkCharacterController.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour` (requires `Rigidbody`)
  - **The primary player controller.** Force-based (acceleration toward target velocity via `Rigidbody.AddForce`), not direct transform manipulation.
  - **Public properties**: `MoveInput` (Vector3 from WASD), `IsGrounded`, `NormalizedSpeed`, `SteeringControl` (multiplier), `SpeedMultiplier`, `CanJump`, `LowGrip`.
  - **Terrain interaction**: Ice (LowGrip=true → momentum carries, weak steering), Water/Mud (SpeedMultiplier < 1 → slow), Mud also blocks jump. Wind via AddForce on the Rigidbody. All modifiers reset each FixedUpdate step and are re-asserted by `TerrainEffectZone.OnTriggerStay`.
  - Jump via Space, with a queued-jump system.
  - Auto-resets `SteeringControl`, `SpeedMultiplier`, `CanJump`, `LowGrip` every physics step — zones re-assert them.

### Wrench Multitool System
The wrench is the primary interactable **multi-tool**:

- **`WrenchConfig.cs`** → `ScriptableObject`
  - Data: swing charge time, damage (light=1, heavy=2), throw distances (3-9 units), throw speed, spin speed, return speed, catch radius.

- **`WrenchSwingController.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour` (requires `PlayerMouseAimer`)
  - Left-click swing. Reads `PlayerMouseAimer.HoveredGameObject` and `WorldAimPoint`. Checks active item is Wrench. Reduced cooldown (0.1s). Calls `PlayerInitializer.EmitHit()` → routes through `ResourceManager` to `ResourceNode`.
  - If `_throw.IsAirborne == true`, swing is disabled.
  - Cooldown-based, no charge windup.

- **`WrenchThrowController.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour` (requires `PlayerMouseAimer`)
  - Right-click hold-to-charge throw. `ThrowChargeTime` (0.8s configurable). Distance scales with charge (min 3m → max 9m).
  - Spawns `ThrownWrench` projectile → flies to target → hovers (`returnDelay` 0.4s) → boomerangs back → caught by `OnCaught()`.
  - Exposes `IsCharging`, `ChargeNormalized`, `IsAirborne` for the aim reticle.

- **`ThrownWrench.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour`
  - 3-phase projectile: Outbound → Hover → Returning. Spins child visual in screen plane. Homing return to `CatchPoint`.

- **`RopeLassoController.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour` (requires `PlayerMouseAimer`)
  - Hold-Q-to-charge, release-to-fire winch grapple.
  - **Dual mode**: `RopeAnchor` → reel player TO the anchor; `RopePullable` → reel the object TO the player.
  - Force-based reeling via `Rigidbody.AddForce`. Suppresses player steering during self-pull.
  - Range-gated by `RopeLassoConfig` (min 2m, max 6m). LineRenderer visual.
  - Blocked on mud (reuses `CanJump` signal).

- **`RopeLassoConfig.cs`** → `ScriptableObject`: charge time, range, pull force, max speed, stop radius, timeout, steering during pull.

- **`WrenchSwingArc.cs`** → visual swipe arc.

### Aiming & Interaction
- **`PlayerMouseAimer.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour` (requires `SolarpunkCharacterController`)
  - **The single source of truth for mouse-over.** Reads `MousePointer.Instance` once per frame.
  - **Public properties**: `WorldAimPoint`, `HoveredResource`, `HoveredPickup`, `HoveredKeyPickup`, `HoveredAnchor`, `HoveredPullable`, `HoveredGrapplePoint`, `SwingAnimIndex` (tool selection), `MeleeResource`, `HoveredInteractable` (`IInteractionPromptProvider`), `HoveredGameObject`.
  - Range-gating: interaction range (3m), melee range (2.5m). No range gate on grapple targets (deferred to the lasso controller).
  - Handles the "miss" case by intersecting the horizontal plane at player Y.

- **`PlayerAimReticle.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour` (requires `PlayerMouseAimer`)
  - Aim reticle with billboarded arrow, charge scaling, colour changes (idle → charging → ready). Currently disabled (root hidden in LateUpdate).

### Inventory System
- **`PlayerInventory.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour`, `[DefaultExecutionOrder(-50)]`
  - **Singleton** inventory manager. Holds a flat array of `InventorySlot`s.
  - Slot 0 = wrench slot, slots 1-N = general item slots (stacking up to `ItemDefinition.maxStack`).
  - **Public API**: `TryAddItem()`, `HasRoomFor()`, `HasItem()`, `RemoveOne()`, `RemoveStack()`. Slot change events: `OnSlotChanged`, `OnActiveSlotChanged`.
  - Hotkeys 1-4 switch active slot. Reads from `InventoryData` SO on Awake.
  - Currency items are rejected (go to `IntVariable` counter instead).

- **`InventorySlot.cs`** → Value type (`struct`)
  - Fields: `ItemDefinition item`, `int count`. Properties: `IsEmpty`, `IsFull`, `MaxStack`, `SpaceLeft`.
  - Static factory `Of(item, count)`.

- **`InventoryData.cs`** → `ScriptableObject`
  - Config: slot count (4 total: 1 wrench + 3 resource slots), default items per slot. Never mutated at runtime.

- **`ItemDefinition.cs`** → `ScriptableObject` (menu: Flynn/Item Definition)
  - Fields: `itemId`, `displayName`, `icon`, `itemType` (ItemType enum), `attackAnimIndex`, `maxStack`, `worldPrefab`, `autoCollect`, `isCurrency`, `currencyTarget` (IntVariable).
  - Tools: Wrench, Pick, Axe, Hammer. Currency items route to `IntVariable`.

- **`ItemType.cs`** → Enum: `None=0, Pick=1, Axe=2, Hammer=3, Wrench=4`.

### Pickup & Drop
- **`PlayerPickupController.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour` (requires `PlayerMouseAimer`)
  - Press E to pick up `WorldItem` from `HoveredKeyPickup`. Grants item to `PlayerInventory` and removes/destroys the world object.

- **`PlayerDropController.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour`
  - Press G to drop 1 unit of active slot. `DropSlot(index)` drops whole stack. Spawns via `WorldItemSpawner` with pop impulse and re-collect delay.

- **`WorldItem.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour` (requires Collider, implements `IInteractionPromptProvider`)
  - The unified world-item unit. Holds an `ItemDefinition` + count. Detection via raycast, no registry. Auto-collect items disable the prompt; key-pickup items show "[E] Pick Up [Name]".

- **`WorldItemPickup.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour` (DEPRECATED — superseded by `WorldItem`). Legacy pickup.

- **`DroppedItemMagnet.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour` (requires `WorldItem`)
  - Auto-collect logic for resource drops. After settle delay (0.6s), flies to player via `PlayerAnchor` reference. Re-checks inventory room. Currencies route to their `IntVariable` counter. `Suppress()` adds extra delay (used on player-dropped items).

- **`WorldItemSpawner.cs`** → spawns WorldItems into the world.

- **`HeldItemSocket.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour`
  - Shows the active inventory item as a cosmetic prop in the character's hand socket. Subscribes to `PlayerInventory` events. Strips physics/pickup from the instance.

- **`InteractionPrompt.cs`** → Value type (struct)
  - Fields: `Key` (E/Q), `Verb` (Pick Up/Grapple/Talk), `Label` (target name), `Anchor`.
  - `IInteractionPromptProvider` interface — extensible interaction prompt system.

### Harvesting & Resources
- **`ResourceNode.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour`
  - Harvestable resource with runtime health. Subscribes to `ResourceManager.OnResourceHit`. Reacts when the hit targets its hierarchy.
  - Exposes: `CurrentHealth`, `MaxHealth`, `Health01`, `RequiredTool`, `DisplayName`, `AttackAnimIndex` (1-4 mapping).
  - Events: `OnDamaged` (C# + UnityEvent), `OnDepleted` (C# + UnityEvent), plus `ResourceHitChannel` for HUD.
  - On depletion, raises events for `ResourceDropSpawner` / `ResourceDeathFall` to react, then self-destructs.

- **`ResourceNodeConfig.cs`** → `ScriptableObject`
  - Data: `displayName`, `requiredTool` (ItemType), `maxHealth`, `drops[]` (DropEntry array), `dropScatterRadius`, `echoShardChancePerHit`, `echoShardItem`.

- **`ResourceManager.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour` `[DefaultExecutionOrder(-100)]`
  - Singleton event bus. `RaiseHit(PlayerHitInfo)` → broadcasts to all subscribers. The player and resources never know each other.

- **`PlayerHitInfo.cs`** → Value type (struct)
  - Properties: `Vector3 Point`, `GameObject Target`, `int Power`.

- **`ResourceDropSpawner.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour` (requires `ResourceNode`)
  - Listens to `OnDepleted`, rolls drop table from `ResourceNodeConfig`, spawns items via `WorldItemSpawner` with pop impulse and scatter.

- **`PlayerInitializer.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour`
  - Wires player to `ResourceManager`. `EmitHit()` is the publish entry point for all player strikes.

- **`HittableSurface.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour`
  - Non-resource melee surface. `SurfaceMaterial` enum (Wood/Metal/Rock). Maps to `AttackAnimIndex`: Wood→Axe(2), Metal→Hammer(3), Rock→Pick(1).

- **`ResourceDeathFall.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour`: Controls resource node topple/fade animation on depletion.

- **`EchoShardRoller.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour`: Per-hit chance to spawn an echo shard (currency).

### Visual / Animation
- **`IPlayerVisual.cs`** → Interface
  - Contract: `VisualCenter`, `VisualGroundCenter`, `IsAttacking`, `TriggerAttack()`, `BeginChargePose()`, `UpdateChargePose()`, `ReleaseSwing()`, `CancelSwing()`, `FaceWorldDirection()`.

- **`FlynnAnimationDriver.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour` (requires `SolarpunkCharacterController`, implements `IPlayerVisual`)
  - Animator-driven sprite-sheet character. Feeds velocity blend tree (VelocityX/Y/Z, Speed, IsGrounded). Handles wrench swing phases (charge windup animation freeze, release with scaled playback speed). Sprite facing by 8-direction sector lookup (per-artwork rules).

- **`ProceduralCharacterDriver.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour` (requires `SolarpunkCharacterController`, implements `IPlayerVisual`)
  - Twin-stick procedural cube rig. BodyRig yaws to mouse aim, LegRig blends to movement direction. Step cycle (foot translate), procedural arm swing. Used for cube/block character.

### Batteries / Energy
- **`RobotBattery.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour` `[DefaultExecutionOrder(-40)]`
  - Singleton. 0-100 battery via `IntVariable`. Has passive drain (placeholder: 1/sec). Exposes `AddCharge()`, `Drain()`, `SetCharge()`, `IsEmpty`, `IsFull`.

### Terrain Zones
- **`TerrainEffectZone.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour` (requires Collider)
  - Trigger volume. `TerrainEffectType` enum: Wind, Water, Mud, Ice.
  - **Wind**: `AddForce` to any Rigidbody inside. Weakens player steering.
  - **Water**: Lowers `SpeedMultiplier`.
  - **Mud**: Lowers `SpeedMultiplier` + blocks jumping while grounded.
  - **Ice**: Lowers `SteeringControl` + sets `LowGrip=true` (momentum carries, no braking).
  - Single-responsibility: one zone, one effect. No statics.

---

## 4. NPC SYSTEM (Assets/Flynn/Scripts/NPC/)

### Architecture
The NPC system is a **fully featured LLM-driven dialogue system** with local (Ollama) and remote (OpenRouter) providers, semantic memory (vector embeddings), and designer-defined signals/triggers.

### Core Components
- **`SceneLlmManager.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour` (singleton)
  - Central manager for NPC dialogue in a scene. Holds: provider selection (local/OpenRouter), model settings, `LlmPromptConfig`, `IslandContentHub`, `DialogueTriggerChannel`, `NpcMemoryStore`, `EmbeddingSettings`, `PlayerDialogueProfile`.
  - Owns the semantic memory DB (`NpcMemoryDatabase`) and embedding provider (`IEmbeddingProvider` → Ollama).
  - On Start: seeds the DB from JSON content (via `IslandDbImporter`), hydrates the hub FROM the DB, backfills legacy embeddings.

- **`DialogueManager.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour` (singleton)
  - The dialogue UI controller. Opens per-NPC chat via `OpenAgent(npcId, portrait, relationshipState)`.
  - Freezes time (Time.timeScale=0) while dialogue is open.
  - Sends player input to local LLM, handles the async reply with a coroutine.
  - **Prompt construction**: system prompt from `LlmPromptConfig` + persona block + community knowledge + resolved context + memory (semantic or legacy) + player profile + JSON output contract.
  - **Semantic recall**: embeds player input + resolved thing context, queries the vector DB for top-k memories, injects into prompt as "Known facts:".
  - **Envelope parsing**: NPC reply includes JSON envelope with `reply`, `topic`, `suggested_player_replies`, `memory_updates[]`, `triggers_fired[]`.
  - Writes memory updates to the DB (with embedding) or legacy store.
  - Fires dialogue signals through `DialogueTriggerChannel` (validated against the turn's signal allowlist).
  - Shows suggested player replies as clickable buttons in the UI.
  - Chat commands: /save, /clear, /help.
  - Has `LlmDebugBus` integration for per-turn debugging.

- **`NpcInteraction.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour`
  - World-space NPC interaction. Detects player proximity (2.5m range). Shows a radial menu of `NpcAction`s. Press E invokes the first available action (typically "Talk" → opens dialogue). Binds action context via `NpcInteractionContext`.
  - Raises `RangeChanged` static event.

- **`NpcRelationshipState.cs`** → `MonoBehaviour`
  - Per-NPC relationship: `trust` (0-100). `AdjustTrust(delta)`, `ResetToDefaults()`.
  - Resolves NPC content from the hub via `NpcId`.

- **`NpcAction.cs`** → Abstract `ScriptableObject`
  - `actionLabel`, `hotkeyHint`. Virtual `IsAvailable(context)`, abstract `Execute(context)`.

- **`TalkAction.cs`** → `NpcAction`: Opens dialogue via `context.npc.OnTalk()`.

### Data / Config
- **`LlmPromptConfig.cs`** → `ScriptableObject`: system prompt, JSON output addendum, recent turns limit, memory facts limit, max fact length.
- **`LocalModelSettings.cs`** → `ScriptableObject`: endpoint URL, model name, temperature, max tokens, timeout.
- **`RemoteModelSettings.cs`** → `ScriptableObject`: endpoint URL, model name, temperature, max tokens, timeout, API key env var, HTTP referer, x-title, force JSON mode.

### Memory

- **`NpcMemoryDatabase.cs`** → Runtime memory DB (LiteDB): stores `MemoryDoc`, `ChatTurnDoc`. Supports vector search (cosine similarity), dedup, CRUD for memories.

## 10. KEY GAMEPLAY LOOPS & INTERACTIONS

### Tool Swing/Harvest Loop
1. Player left-clicks → `WrenchSwingController.DoSwing()` → reads `PlayerMouseAimer.WorldAimPoint` + `HoveredGameObject`
2. Calls `PlayerInitializer.EmitHit(point, target, damage)` → `ResourceManager.RaiseHit(PlayerHitInfo)`
3. `ResourceManager` broadcasts to all subscribers → target `ResourceNode.HandleResourceManagerHit()` confirms ownership
4. `ResourceNode.ReceiveHit(damage)` → reduces health, raises `OnDamaged` (C# + UnityEvent + HitChannel for HUD)
5. When health == 0 → `OnDepleted` → `ResourceDropSpawner` rolls drop table, spawns items → `DroppedItemMagnet` auto-collects if room in inventory

### Rope Lasso Loop
1. Player holds Q → reads `PlayerMouseAimer.HoveredAnchor` or `HoveredPullable` → launches on release
2. `RopeAnchor` = reel PLAYER to anchor point (self-pull, suppresses steering)
3. `RopePullable` = reel object TO the player (AddForce toward hand)
4. LineRenderer draws the rope during pull. Pull ends on distance threshold or timeout.

### NPC Dialogue Loop
1. Player walks near NPC (2.5m) → `NpcInteraction` detects, shows radial menu
2. Press E → `TalkAction.Execute()` → `NpcInteraction.OnTalk()` → `DialogueManager.OpenAgent(npcId)`
3. Dialogue time-freezes (Time.timeScale=0)
4. Player types/sends text → `DialogueManager.SubmitPlayerInput()` → builds system prompt with persona, community, resolved context, semantic memory recall
5. Sends to local/remote LLM → receives JSON envelope: reply, topic, suggestions, memory updates, trigger signals
6. Applies reply to UI, writes memory updates to DB (with embedding), fires dialogue triggers through event channel

## Comprehensive Codebase Analysis — C# Scripts in Unity Project

I read ~70+ files across the entire codebase. The main game code lives under **`Assets/Flynn/`** (not `Assets/Scripts/`, which contains only demo/prototype scripts). Below is a thorough breakdown organized by system.

---

## 1. ASSETS/SCRIPTS (Demo / Prototype folder — 9 files)

These are lightweight demos for LLM NPC chat, intro sequences, and 2D tilemap running.

### `Assets/Scripts/Demos/LlmChat/Runtime/Gameplay/`
- **`Game.cs`**: Empty placeholder `MonoBehaviour` — no logic.
- **`IsometricCameraFollow.cs`**: Smooth-follow camera. Public: `target` (Transform), `smoothSpeed`. Tracks a target with lerp offset.
- **`IsometricGridBuilder.cs`**: Builds an isometric checkerboard floor (BoxCollider + visual quads) at Awake. Width/depth, two colours. The Collider is for a CharacterController.
- **`PlayerBillboard.cs`**: Faces child sprite toward camera Y-axis (isometric stable billboarding).
- **`PlayerController.cs`**: Isometric CharacterController-based movement. Uses `IsoRight (1,0,-1)`/`IsoForward (1,0,1)` axes. Has a visual "bounce" system (sine-wave squash/stretch, Z-axis lean). Clamped to grid bounds.

### `Assets/Scripts/Demos/IntroSequence/Runtime/`
- **`IntroSequencePlayer.cs`**: Full cinematic intro system using UI Toolkit. Plays a sequence of text boxes with typewriter effect (per-character fade-in), frame fade transitions, and a final full-screen fade-to-game. Supports Space-to-skip. Configurable timing, font, responsive layout. Uses unscaled time by default. The `PlaySequence()` coroutine manages the show.

### `Assets/Scripts/Demos/LLM Demo/`
- **`Mover.cs`**: Simple point-A-to-point-B ping-pong movement.

### `Assets/Scripts/Demos/PrototypeRunner/Runtime/`
- **`SimpleSquareRunner2D.cs`**: 2D top-down movement on a Tilemap (probes 9 sample points for walkability). Has deceleration/acceleration, sprite flip on facing, run bounce (squash/stretch), and a direction-indicator arrow (TextMeshPro) that smoothly rotates.
- **`PrototypeActionFeedbackSystem.cs`**: Singleton world-space feedback popup (fades in, rises, holds, fades out). 4 tones (Info/Success/Warning/Error). Triggers after the intro sequence. Deployable via static `Show()`.

---

## 2. ASSETS/FLYNN — THE MAIN GAME

### SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE PATTERN
The codebase follows a consistent **observer/event-channel pattern**:
- **Singleton managers** (`ResourceManager`, `PlayerInventory`, `UIManager`, `RobotBattery`, `SceneLlmManager`) — early execution order, reached via `Instance`.
- **ScriptableObject event channels** (`ResourceHitChannel`, `DialogueTriggerChannel`, `RecalledKnowledgeChannel`) — decouple producers from consumers.
- **`PlayerMouseAimer`** as the single source of truth for mouse-over detection (reads `MousePointer` singleton).
- **`IPlayerVisual` interface** — decouples wrench/throw/rope controllers from the visual body (legacy sprite-sheet driver OR procedural cube rig).

---

## 3. PLAYER SYSTEM (Assets/Flynn/Scripts/Player/)

### Core Movement
